notes: Settings → Email Senders' "Login" button (for Hostinger-hosted mailboxes) now auto-fills BOTH the email and password fields on Hostinger's own webmail login page, not just email — you still click Login yourself. The password never travels through a URL: the page hands it to the extension via a one-time event the moment you click, it's staged briefly in extension-only storage, and the new tab's content script reads and deletes it the instant it's used.
